newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Goodman says finance director resigns.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Goodman says finance director resigns.

text.p: Australasian food group Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Tuesday that finance director Les Cullen had resigned to pursue other interests.
Goodman said in a statement released in Wellington that Cullen would leave the company after the annual meeting on November 15 "to pursue more broadly based management responsiblities elsewhere".
Goodman said Cullen would remain with the company while the search for a replacement continued.

Goodman Fielder managing director David Hearn later told a media briefing in Sydney that the first quarter had been satisfactory for the company and he would be making a full year profit forecast at the annual meeting.
"The start of the year has been pretty satisfactory," Hearn said. "We are reasonably happy with the first quarter."
